import app
# A slow test run: about 20 seconds.
time.sleep(20)
cases = [("greet", app.greet("Ada") == "Hello, Ada!"), ("total", app.total([1, 2, 3]) == 6)]
for name, ok in cases:
    print(("ok   " if ok else "FAIL ") + name)
failed = [n for n, ok in cases if not ok]
print("tests passed" if not failed else f"{len(failed)} test(s) failed")
